applicabilityBasis.summary: Fluid DigitalDollar was historically described as a transferable USD-referenced token minted from treasury-account USD, burned on return and redeemable to a bank account at 1:1. The issuer-authored December 31, 2021 FAQ supports apparent payment-stablecoin treatment of that historical instrument. Frozen status and unverified current operations are separate facts.

references.label: Fluid Finance December 31, 2021 DUSD FAQ text via Jina retrieval mirror

genius.notes: Fluid Finance SA, en liquidation is preserved as the historical legal issuer. The Swiss Official Gazette records bankruptcy dissolution effective April 22, 2024. The issuer-authored December 31, 2021 FAQ was independently reopened through a same-page text mirror and describes USD minting, transfers and 1:1 DUSD redemption. It does not establish a current operational redemption policy. The coin remains frozen; current reserves, redemption availability and U.S. distribution are unverified. Reserve, redemption and monthly-attestation presence flags are therefore omitted, rather than inferring current presence or absence from archived material or inaccessible websites. No general enforcement finding is asserted. The bounded public-source review found no token-specific GENIUS permission; the SCRC procedural rule does not establish issuer qualification.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No public GENIUS PPSI approval, state qualification, official GENIUS application or registered foreign exception was located for Fluid Finance SA or historical Fluid DigitalDollar in the named public sources through the 2026-10-07 review. The Federal Register exact-name query returned no documents; the OCC active charter applicant table and NYDFS directory contained no issuer/token match. General rulemaking sources do not authorize this issuer. Historical issuer materials establish payment/redemption design only; current operating disclosures were unavailable. This bounded negative review does not establish that no unpublished filing exists.
